title: Orchid window checkpad and release crib notes (Mar 2026)
content:
Purpose:
A compact, operator-friendly runbook for the Orchid release window. Focus: low-latency routing changes + small model variant rollout to 3 regions. This is a working scratchpad — incomplete, lots of TODOs and explicit checks.

Scope & Constraints:
- Components touched: model-router, traffic-shaper, cache layer, console rollout gates.
- Regions: us-west1 (primary), eu-west1 (staggered + 2h later), ap-southeast1 (follow-up + reduced traffic).
- Target percent rollout: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 6 hours with decision gates at each step.
- SLA-sensitive endpoints: /v1/generate-chat and /v1/embeddings (throttle if latency > 250ms p50 or error rate > 0.8%).

Calendar (local times):
- T-72h: Final smoke test & perf bump recorded (owner: Mateo).
- T-24h: Freeze branch + create release bundle (owner: Sofia).
- Go window (day-of):
  - 09:00 PT: Preflight standup (15m) — confirm telemetry panels, on-call roster, comms.
  - 09:30 PT: Canary seed 10% us-west1 (step 1) — observe 30m.
  - 10:10 PT: Decision checkpoint (telemetry digest) -> move to 30% or rollback.
  - 11:30 PT: Expand to 60% (if green) -> observe 60m.
  - 13:00 PT: Full roll to 100% (if green) and start followups in eu/ap per stagger plan.
  - 15:30 PT: Post-rollout validation (user-facing smoke checks + docs publish).

Preflight checklist (must be green before T-24h):
- [ ] Finalized migration plan for routing table (PR merged and tagged). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/789
- [ ] Canary config generated and validated in dev cluster (Mateo)
- [ ] Dark traffic test run completed vs baseline 2026-03-10 trace
- [ ] Alert runbooks linked in PagerDuty service (service id in Confluence page)
- [ ] Backfill keys / KMS docs validated (Priya)
- [ ] Communication templates ready (customer status, internal ticker)
- [ ] Telemetry dashboards: latency, errors, traffic per model, token/sec, cost sampling — pinned and saved

Night-of / Day-of operator script (quick):
1) Preflight standup: quick round-robin (SRE, Serving, Router, Console, Release lead)
2) Snapshot current traffic and save (curl to admin snapshot endpoint)
3) Apply canary via routing API: POST /admin/routing/canary with payload (10% weight -> model_v2)
4) Start 30m watch: run smoke scripts (./scripts/smoke-orchid.sh) and sample 200 requests across routes
5) At checkpoint, prepare rollback command if threshold exceeded: rollback = POST /admin/routing/rollback?tag=orchid-TIMESTAMP
6) Expand weights per plan. Annotate each decision in #release-ops thread with timestamp + telemetry screenshot

Automated checks & pass/fail criteria (decision gates):
- Stability gate: p95 latency increase < 15% vs baseline AND error rate delta < 0.5 percentage points
- Quality gate: BLEU/semantic-qa quick-run (sampled prompts) show no regressions > 2 points on eval harness (see ENG-2345)
- Cost gate: token/sec cost delta < 20% (if exceeded, pause and consult Optimize)

Rollback playbook (condensed):
- Trigger: gate failure OR customer-impacting alerts > 5 min
- Owner: Release lead (Sofia) + Router owner (Mateo)
- Steps:
  1) Run rollback API: POST /admin/routing/set?model=model_v1&weight=100 (auth token in vault)
  2) If routing API failing, revert infra via previous config: kubectl apply -f /releases/orchid/rollback-config.yaml
  3) Inform CS & Execs: use prewritten template (linked in Confluence)
  4) Open an incident page and tag team leads (use incident template in Confluence)

Communications matrix:
- Internal watch: #release-ops (primary), #sre (escalation), #platform (FYI)
- PagerDuty: on-call SRE -> escalate to eng-leads if > 15 minutes unresolved
- Customer-facing: Draft status update (short) + link to postmortem (if rollback). Template lives at Confluence page above.

Post-release tasks (first 24h):
- [ ] Confirm ingestion and retention of telemetry snapshots for 24h baseline comparison (Ethan)
- [ ] Publish release notes (customer-facing) and update product changelog (Sofia)
- [ ] Run full eval suite overnight (batch job id: orchid-eval-2026-03-16)
- [ ] Schedule retro + incident review (if any anomalies) at +48h

Draft release notes (for product/changelog) — short form:
Orchid rollout (beta model_v2) — 2026-03-16
- Incremental rollout of model_v2 with improved prefix-caching for multi-turn chat.
- Expected: lower p99 generation CPU use and modest latency improvement for multi-turn flows.
- Known limitations: Slightly different tokenization edge-cases on code snippets — flagged to research team.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Who signs the customer-facing brief for EU customers? (Action: Priya to confirm legal/locale copy)
- Need a pre-sliced prompt set for the quick quality gate (SRE wants 50 more examples)
- Confirm quota bump for dedicated tenants using model_v2 in ap-southeast1 (action: Sofia to check sales commit)
- Can we light up a cost-aware throttle in the router if token/sec cost delta > X? (follow-up with Optimize team)

Appendix (commands & links):
- Smoke script: ./scripts/smoke-orchid.sh (runs 200 synthetic requests, outputs latency histogram)
- Snapshot traffic: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://admin.redwood.ai/v1/traffic/snapshot > snapshot-$(date +%s).json
- Rollback config path: /releases/orchid/rollback-config.yaml in repo (PR merged: #789)
- Key dashboards to pin: Orchids -> orchid-latency, orchid-errors, routing-weight, token-cost-sampler

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep comms crisp — customers only care if latency or errors change. Keep blame-free language.
- If we see regional divergence (eu vs us), prefer regional pause vs global rollback to preserve traffic in healthy regions.
- Remember to update the model catalog entry with the new quantization details after full roll.

-- end scratch --
